applicableDomain: Hospital Pharmacy Inventory, FEFO Batch/Lot Dispensing & Controlled-Drug Witness Verification
descriptionAndPurpose: Routes signed prescriptions into the pharmacy dispensing queue, enforces CDSS interaction screening and FEFO (First-Expired-First-Out) non-expired lot selection, requires dual witness for controlled substances, and issues privacy-minimized pickup alerts.
prerequisiteConditions: Signed prescription orderId and non-expired, non-quarantined FEFO lot inventory.
safetyChecks: Expired or recall-quarantined lots are hard-blocked from dispensing.
Controlled narcotics require independent second-pharmacist witness.
Privacy-minimized pickup notifications never disclose sensitive drug names in plaintext SMS.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: PHARMACY clearance evaluated via WorkflowBillingClearancePolicySpi; emergency resuscitation meds use EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Uncollected medications returned to stock reverse inventory allocation cleanly without deleting the signed clinician prescription.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: @ClinicalAudit logs verifying pharmacist, lot/expiry dispensed, controlled-drug witness, and counseling confirmation.
completionCriteria: Medication dispensed from valid FEFO lot with counseling recorded, or external pharmacy handoff logged.
